_comment: Committed APPROVED research/scrape source allow-list (template). The bot may ONLY consider sources listed here — never arbitrary URLs. This patch is SELECTION-ONLY: no source is fetch_allowed and the selector performs no network calls. It never scrapes paywalled, login-only, auth-required, robots/ToS-prohibited, or disabled sources. scrape_mode: disabled | metadata_only | manual_review_only | fetch_allowed.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR filings (public)
sources.notes: Public filings. Respect SEC fair-access rate limits and User-Agent policy. Metadata only in this patch.

sources.name: Company investor-relations RSS
sources.notes: Per-issuer public IR feeds. Configure exact feed URLs in your local copy.

sources.name: Options chain / catalyst research (manual)
sources.notes: A reminder to manually review options chains / catalysts; the bot does not fetch.

sources.name: Market-data diagnostics (manual)
sources.notes: Prompt to investigate measurement/liquidity issues (e.g. no_baseline) rather than ingest more news.

sources.name: Example paywalled/login source (DISABLED)
sources.notes: Illustrates a source the selector must NEVER choose: disabled, paywalled, and auth-required.
